design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 1 (water_mitigation_billing), revision 2. Draw (scripts/draw_counts.py --task 1): prerequisite_problems=1, factor_counts=[6,6]; water_ext_final_hepa_vacuum=6, water_ext_insured_share=6.
WHY A GOOD TEST: an insured homeowner asks only to pay "her part" of an insurance-funded water job. The scored figure (the insured's share, 3504.43) is fixed only after the final HEPA vacuuming line exists (the job is in drying_complete status, carries pad removal lines and no hepa_vacuum line). The HEPA line is priced by six rules; the share stacks the insured's own finance charges with six non-covered amounts read from the job lines and the linked claim file, billed because the Direction to Pay arrangement bills declined lines to the customer.
SCOPE: task 1 claims water_ext_final_hepa_vacuum and water_ext_insured_share with book_final_hepa_eb899e1c and pay_insured_share_cc172b06; task 0 holds debris, antimicrobial and the drying deposit (disjoint). The world already carries the task-0 tear-out lines priced by those rules (debris 1530.10, antimicrobial 1500.24, both dated 2026-09-28), so no task-0 obligation is lit; the HEPA rule applies only in drying_complete status, so it is not lit in task 0's authorized job.
CLAIM FILE: Direction to Pay, approved 2026-10-02 for the submitted estimate (13182.92 = the job's charges at submission less the card surcharge, less every lead-safe and asbestos line, which code work goes through the ordinance or law coverage by supplement, and less the premium, air-mover and LGR amounts the non-covered rules exclude); code-upgrade supplement 1 (2026-10-03, naming this water job, 770.00 = the job's lead-safe setup 345.00 + asbestos sampling 425.00) approved 2026-10-05 for 500.00; carrier receivable 13682.92 (no carrier payment yet); ordinance or law limit 1000.00; deductible 1500.00 assessed on the file. The carrier funds 500.00 of the 770.00 code work and the share bills the other 270.00, so the work is funded once.
PROBLEM-TREE CARD: root water_ext_insured_share (owner=user tool). Edge share<-HEPA: value_input, gate sh_hepa_sqft, form state, sentence "The insured's share of a job whose drying is complete and whose final invoice has not yet been issued, and that carries pad removal or carpet removal lines, is fixed only after the job carries a HEPA vacuuming line." False at opening: status drying_complete, pad_removal 820 sq ft, no hepa_vacuum row; resolved by book_final_hepa_eb899e1c (the only rule booking a HEPA vacuuming line). Direction affirmative. Deletion sensitivity: skip HEPA -> share 1449.75 instead of 3504.43.
FACTOR CARD (tier taken; result with that factor alone at baseline):
- HEPA (result 2308.88 = 7448.00 sq ft x 0.31; all-baseline 254.20 = 820 x 0.31): lifted_carpet_back 'carpet detach-and-reset and pad removal lines' -> 820 + 1100 = 1920 [1354.08]; cut_cavity_vacuum 'category_2 with flood cut lines' -> 104 x 2 = 208 [2128.34]; moved_contents_vacuum 'category_2 or category_3 with contents manipulation lines' -> 4 x 120 = 480 [1892.24]; bottom_plate_strip 'class_2 with baseboard lines' -> 104 x 0.5 = 52 [2263.74]; regulated_dust_passes 'built before the RRP cutoff with a lead-safe setup line' -> 2 [1154.44]; silt_residue_pass 'two or more days' -> 1.4 [1649.20]. Square feet (1920 + 208 + 480 + 52) x 2 x 1.4 = 7448.00.
- share (result 3504.43; all-baseline 82.50 = 17.70 surcharge + 1 room beyond one per 400 sq ft x 64.80): code_upgrade_supplement_decision (cross-difficulty claims) 'the latest code-upgrade request names this job and carries a carrier approval' -> code work covered = 500.00 approved, so 770.00 - 500.00 = 270.00 non-covered (baseline: the 1000.00 limit covers all 770.00) [3234.43]; emergency_premium_timing 'premium above zero, opened two or more days after loss' -> whole premium 76.65 [3427.78]; air_mover_placement_cap 'class_2' -> (19 + 8) x 6 = 162 covered of 180 -> 18 x 28.50 = 513.00 [2991.43]; lgr_iicrc_sizing 'class_2 with LGR lines' -> 3 x 6 = 18 covered of 24 -> 6 x 95.40 = 572.40 [2932.03]; hepa_stripped_floor_cover 'category_2 with HEPA lines' -> 7448 - 820 = 6628 x 0.31 = 2054.68 [1449.75]; contents_room_block 'category_2 with contents lines' -> block 300, 4 rooms covered, 0 non-covered (baseline block 400 leaves 1 room, 64.80) [3569.23].
Near-misses: the 600.00 credit card payment is a payment, not part of the share (its 17.70 surcharge is); the deductible (1500.00) sits on the claim file and is never charged on a job; the carrier's initial approval equals the covered scope and covers none of the regulated lines; its only supplement approval is the 500.00 it allowed on this job's 770.00 code-upgrade request, and the rule takes that decision rather than the unused room under the 1000.00 limit; the sixth equipment day and the monitoring visits are covered (the caps act on unit counts).
BASE-INVARIANT CARD: HEPA is a water_mitigation_service_charge: service_state holds (drying_complete); the share is a water_customer_payment: pay_state holds. No time gate.
BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD: job c789a250-5ec2-49f6-ba8e-d686ab664098; claim file 9c0c47c6-bf5a-4d13-a2cc-5d14b6cbcaf1 read for ordinance_law_limit and its arrangement's denied_line_billable_to_customer, with its code-upgrade supplement request naming this job and the approval deciding it; aggregates read only this job's lines.
SEED: Gray Water - Standard Loss rates; service call 219 x 1.35 after-hours (arrival 96 <= 120); 6 equipment days 2026-09-29..2026-10-04 (cap 5, day 6 supported by the 2026-10-04 monitoring visit); 5 monitoring visits (set day waived); credit card payment 600.00 with its 2.95 percent surcharge 17.70.
PERSONA: volunteers goal (pay her part today), tender (bank transfer), the 600 already paid; identity on request; consents when told a charge must be added; pays the stated amount when handed the tool; never names HEPA or any non-covered item.
VERIFICATION: evalc.py (check_compute engine) on the handling-time world reproduces HEPA 2308.88 and share 3504.43; half-cent scan clear.
DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM VISIBLE CONTEXT: the published HEPA and insured-share rules, the tool schemas and the nine read returns give the same two writes.
REVISIONS: round 4 keyed the regulated-materials treatment on the code-upgrade supplement naming this job (approved amount / pending amount up to the limit / the limit), the supplement reseeded to name this job (770.00 asked, 500.00 approved); round 3 had subtracted a file-wide commitment from the limit. Round 2: share ladders rebuilt (billability scope from the claims arrangement, code work methods, premium by dispatch timing, rooms by category block, LGR sizing as a method, aggregate wording); HEPA floor factor reshaped; tier labels corrected.
BLUEPRINT-KNOWN candidate: the frozen water charter has no insured-share concept; the share is an extended rule built from base facts (insurance proceeds never surcharged, claims ordinance or law limit, claims denied-line billability).
user_scenario: You are Celeste Arnaud, a retired schoolteacher who owns her house at 4127 Elysian Fields Avenue in New Orleans. You speak warmly but you like things spelled out, and you keep your insurance letters in a folder on the kitchen table while you talk. While you were away visiting your sister the weekend of September 26, the washing machine hose split and flooded the living room and hall. The restoration company came out the evening of the 28th, pulled up the wet pad, cut the bottom of the walls, moved furniture out of four rooms and ran fans and dehumidifiers until Sunday, October 4. Your homeowner's claim is with Crescent Bay Insurance Company, and you signed the company's direction to pay so the insurer pays them directly. Your adjuster told you the claim was approved for the company's estimate, but that some things on a contractor's bill are not covered and are yours to pay. You are calling because you want to pay your part of the water job today, meaning the part your insurance will not pay, so it is off your mind. You will pay it yourself through the company's secure payment system, by bank transfer from your checking account. You already put 600 dollars on your credit card toward the job on October 3, and you do not know what the rest of your part comes to, so you do not guess. You give your name at the start. When the agent asks for details to find or verify you, you give your phone number, 5045550163, and if they ask for another detail, your billing ZIP code, 70122; your email, celeste.arnaud.nola@gmail.com, only if they still need more. If they ask for the claim number, it is CBH-26-1417, and the address is your house. If the agent asks about your deductible, you say your adjuster told you the deductible is handled on the insurance claim itself. If the agent tells you a charge for the job still has to be put on before your part can be worked out, you say that is fine, go ahead. When the agent tells you what your part comes to, you accept it, because you trust them to read the insurance file correctly. When the agent hands you the secure payment step, you pay exactly that amount by bank transfer on the Elysian Fields water job. Once the payment is confirmed you thank them, jot down the confirmation number, and say goodbye.
